description: Pittston, PA - Speaker of the House Mike Johnson joined Congressman Rob Bresnahan in Pennsylvania’s 8th Congressional District today, highlighting Bresnahan’s work on behalf of Northeastern Pennsylvania and rallying supporters ahead of November’s election.

title: Speaker Mike Johnson Joins Rep. Rob Bresnahan in PA-08 to Rally Support, Expose Paige Cognetti’s Radical Record Ahead of November Midterms - Rob for PA
